target: Price change divided by median training price, independently per CPU/GPU
selectionPolicy: One fixed candidate; no tuning or promotion based on these scores.
mergePolicy: Append five distinct regions; preserve public global AZ IDs separately from original account-specific AZ names. Never fill beyond the public source window. Reject conflicting events and retain original dataset unchanged.
hardwarePolicy: Reuse verified original AWS instance-type GPU/vCPU counts for the same named instance types; public prices establish history, not current regional offerings or capacity.
comparisonPolicy: Frozen saved incumbent on identical targets. Incumbent uses its existing persistence fallback on unsupported regional pools. No combined CPU/GPU dollar MAE; new-region coverage gains are separate from same-pool accuracy gains.
